text:
vikram: quick heads-up  planning to flip pulse-9b-quantv1 in the catalog tonight in the 00:30-02:30 UTC window. need agreement on priming strategy, fallback priority, and a short emergency revert ladder.

deploy-bot: scheduled by @vikram for 3544449000. Canary flow: 1% for 10m -> 10% for 20m -> 40% for 20m. Auto-rollback if canary_error_rate > 1.2% OR p95 latency > 1.1s.

zoe: my take: warm KV/prefix only on canary nodes (staged warmup). if NA passes, do an opt-in EU warmup (manual_go). avoids big cross-region spikes.

trent: +1. also recommend a 75% host_mem_threshold to trigger immediate drain. EU had swap churn last month.

sre-pager: we'll watch memory and eviction metrics. oncall will post go/no-go after first 1% tranche. if evictions > 5/min or host_mem_avg > 75% we call immediate_drain.

vikram: fallback ladder proposal:
```yaml
fallback_order:
  - pulse-9b-quantv1
  - pulse-9b-quant
  - pulse-9b
fallback_debounce_minutes: 12
promotion_hold_minutes: 8
regional_priming: na_manual_then_eu
pin_lock_minutes: 80
```
keeps quantv1 first but bounded promotion and avoids oscillation.

zoe: add note: if fallback happens, keep traffic on the fallback for promotion_hold_minutes before any automatic promotion back. reduces flip-flop.

release-cop: small release config snippet for release-bot (paste into the job):
```json
{"model":"pulse-9b-quantv1","canary_pct":1,"canary_minutes":10,"ramp_pct":10,"pin_lock_minutes":80,"warmup":"canary_only","eu_priming":"manual_go","fallback_debounce_minutes":12}
```

trent: i'll wire the dashboards: canary_error_rate, fallback_count, host_mem_avg, p95_heatmap. ETA 25m.

sre-pager: we'll be on pager during rollout. will call for manual_drain if thresholds breached.

vikram: final checklist: (1) release-bot schedule set, (2) warmup=canary_only, (3) eu_priming=manual_go, (4) fallback and debounce as above, (5) pin_lock=80m, (6) dashboards + alerts live. any objections?

zoe: no objections. posting a short release note mentioning EU manual warmup and the 80m pin lock.

deploy-bot: preflight checks OK. Canary containers healthy. Will start at scheduled epoch unless aborted.

vikram: launching at 3544449000. ping here immediately to request rollback/abort. :rocket:
